initial_conditions: Debian 13.7 ARM64 with X11 and Vulkan software rendering, an original two-panel shirt and an isolated runtime network namespace.
actions: Build and package the studio and CLI with cargo xtask package. Compare the copied executables and notices to their sources.
Create and inspect the original shirt, run one CPU step and export OBJ, SVG and GLB with the packaged CLI.
Open and close the packaged studio on the original shirt, retain a workspace frame and check the editable file digest.
Compare GLB geometry with independently parsed OBJ and validate the GLB with Khronos Validator.
expected_outcomes: Both executables match Cargo; the studio displays the shirt and closes cleanly; the one-step CLI run stays finite; the editable file is preserved and rest GLB matches OBJ geometry with zero validator errors or warnings.
